DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Counter the siege of the zombie heroes with the plant heroes!
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 与植物英雄们一起挫败僵尸英雄们的入侵计划！

Introduction.en: Little known fact: When she takes of the cape and mask, she goes by the name Penelopea. Shoots huge peas that splits on impact.
Introduction.zh: 冷知识：她脱下披风和面具时，以佩涅洛豌豆之名生活。发射巨大的会炸开的豌豆

BriefIntroduction.en: Little known fact: When she takes of the cape and mask, she goes by the name Penelopea. Shoots huge peas that splits on impact.
BriefIntroduction.zh: 冷知识：她脱下披风和面具时，以佩涅洛豌豆之名生活。发射巨大的会炸开的豌豆

Introduction.en: When she's on fire, she's on FIRE. And so are the zombies. Generate sun at super speed.
Introduction.zh: 当她热情高涨的时候，她真的会着火。僵尸也是。以超高速度生产阳光

BriefIntroduction.en: When she's on fire, she's on FIRE. And so are the zombies. Generate sun at super speed.
BriefIntroduction.zh: 当她热情高涨的时候，她真的会着火。僵尸也是。以超高速度生产阳光

Introduction.en: He's a great guy - he just sometimes has a hard time coming out of his shell. Endures anything but smashing...
Introduction.zh: 他是个好植，不过常常钻不出他的盔甲。抵抗除砸击外的一切攻击...

BriefIntroduction.en: He's a great guy - he just sometimes has a hard time coming out of his shell. Endures anything but smashing...
BriefIntroduction.zh: 他是个好植，不过常常钻不出他的盔甲。抵抗除砸击外的一切攻击...

Introduction.en: If you want to see him blow his top, try calling him 'Stumpy'. Go on. Try it. Ignites passing pea shots, and burns zombies with intense heat.
Introduction.zh: 如果你想看他暴怒，叫他一句矮树墩子。去试试看。点燃豌豆子弹，并以超高温度灼烧僵尸

BriefIntroduction.en: If you want to see him blow his top, try calling him 'Stumpy'. Go on. Try it. Ignites passing pea shots, and burns zombies with intense heat.
BriefIntroduction.zh: 如果你想看他暴怒，叫他一句矮树墩子。去试试看。点燃豌豆子弹，并以超高温度灼烧僵尸

Introduction.en: He's the best at what he does... and what he does is punching! Punches zombies around him heavily.
Introduction.zh: 他最擅长他做的事...他做的事便是肘击！沉重的肘击他周围的僵尸

BriefIntroduction.en: He's the best at what he does... and what he does is punching! Punches zombies around him heavily.
BriefIntroduction.zh: 他最擅长他做的事...他做的事便是肘击！沉重的肘击他周围的僵尸

Introduction.en: He's a fun guy. Blast spores rapidly at every zombie in front of him.
Introduction.zh: 他是个有趣的植。对面前的所有僵尸迅速喷射孢子攻击

BriefIntroduction.en: He's a fun guy. Blast spores rapidly at every zombie in front of him.
BriefIntroduction.zh: 他是个有趣的植。对面前的所有僵尸迅速喷射孢子攻击

Introduction.en: Always tries to keep his head in tough situations. Always loses it. Arms super-quickly and devastates any zombie in its radius. Spudow!
Introduction.zh: 在逆境中总是试图保住他的头，但总是丢。超快的准备并破坏一切范围内的僵尸，土豆爆炸！

BriefIntroduction.en: Always tries to keep his head in tough situations. Always loses it. Arms super-quickly and devastates any zombie in its radius. Spudow!
BriefIntroduction.zh: 在逆境中总是试图保住他的头，但总是丢。超快的准备并破坏一切范围内的僵尸，土豆爆炸！

Introduction.en: She flosses every meal and still, Zombie Breath is a real problem. Devour whole zombies one by one and non-stop, or bites with a lethal chomp.
Introduction.zh: 她每次用餐后都剔牙，但口中有僵尸臭味仍然是一个大麻烦。不停的一个接一个吞噬整只僵尸，或用致命的撕咬攻击

Introduction.en: Wanted to be a poet, but couldn't find anything that rhymed with orange. Shoots plasma devastating to hordes of zombies.
Introduction.zh: 想做诗人，但找不到和橘子押韵的东西。发射有概率魅惑僵尸的魔法弹。发射等离子体对成群的僵尸造成巨大伤害

Introduction.en: Refuses to be nerfed. Shoots magic blasts with a chance to hypnotize zombies.
Introduction.zh: 拒绝被削弱。发射有概率魅惑僵尸的魔法弹

Introduction.en: As leader of the Plant-etary Guard, she's ready to root out Zombies wherever they crop up. Revives defeated plants with a boosted health.
Introduction.zh: 作为植物警备队的队长，她时刻准备将僵尸连根铲除。复活战败的植物并增强其耐久
